source: BV-BRC (bv-brc.org), annotations from CARD, NDARO, VFDB, PATRIC_VF
genome_phenotype_rule: A genome is labelled Resistant when it has more Resistant than Susceptible lab-measured antibiotic results, otherwise Susceptible. Genomes with no lab-measured AMR data are labelled Unknown and counted as neither. Intermediate results are excluded.
caveats: sp_gene calls are computational annotations, not laboratory measurements.
Helicobacter pylori is included for virulence only; it has 265 lab-measured AMR rows and no resistance statistic should be quoted for it.
Genomes are not deduplicated by strain, so clonal oversampling in the public database can inflate any within-cluster concentration.
